title: Add Color Picker
content: Create color picker. Trigger: button showing current color swatch (w-10 h-10 rounded border). Dropdown: absolute bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl p-4. Preset colors: grid grid-cols-8 gap-2, small swatches (w-6 h-6 rounded cursor-pointer). Custom input: hex input field. Preview: large swatch showing selected color. Actions: cancel and apply buttons.

variants.simple: Create color picker with palette and custom input.
variants.detailed: Create color picker. Trigger: button showing current color swatch (w-10 h-10 rounded border). Dropdown: absolute bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl p-4. Preset colors: grid grid-cols-8 gap-2, small swatches (w-6 h-6 rounded cursor-pointer). Custom input: hex input field. Preview: large swatch showing selected color. Actions: cancel and apply buttons.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive color picker. Trigger: color swatch button with dropdown arrow, current color preview. Picker modes: preset palette, gradient picker, input values. Gradient picker: saturation/brightness square with hue slider below, draggable marker. Hue slider: horizontal rainbow gradient, draggable handle. Alpha slider: optional opacity control with checkerboard background. Value inputs: hex (#RRGGBB), RGB (3 inputs), HSL (3 inputs), tab switcher between formats. Preset palettes: common colors, recent colors (localStorage), saved colors. Recent: last 8-10 used colors, click to select. Custom palettes: predefined brand colors, theme colors. Preview: old vs new color comparison. Eye dropper: EyeDropper API to pick color from screen (where supported). Copy: button to copy current color value. Color names: show nearest named color. Validation: reject invalid hex input, clamp RGB 0-255. Keyboard: arrow keys adjust values, Tab between inputs. Accessibility: proper labeling, keyboard operable gradient picker alternative. Mobile: touch-friendly slider handles. Output: onChange fires with { hex, rgb, hsl, alpha } object.
